answer: The island schedule is applied in signal and horizon shows each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4796 identities would post 2975 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
